entities.name: José Ramón Carabante
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
José Ramón Carabante is a Spanish businessman, who owned the Hispania Racing 
Formula One team. Carebante owns a number of Spanish businesses including Grupo Hispania, a property management company with a variety of interests in Europe and America, and the CB Murcia basketball team. He was a shareholder in the Campos Meta F1 team, which had gained an entry for the 2010 Formula One season, before taking full control when the team ran into financial difficulties shortly before the start of the season.
